record.title: Technology vendor or outsourced infrastructure under accountable-client controls
kv: Legal basis

Service contract plus the accountable client's applicable statutory and regulatory obligations. For supervised banking organizations, SR 23-4 gives risk-management guidance for third-party relationships and explicitly creates no new requirements.
When it applies
A regulated or contractually accountable firm uses a vendor, linked ledger, database, wallet system, or infrastructure provider to perform part of its operating model.
Named firms
Circle Technology Services, LLC (role documented); Arc Network Services LLC (role documented)
Who can use it
software vendor; cloud or infrastructure provider; ledger/database provider; wallet or key-management vendor; systems integrator; recordkeeping transfer agent using linked technical systems
Conditions

Identify the client that retains the regulated or contractual duty. Recover the vendor agreement, data/control access, security, continuity, audit, incident, correction, and exit provisions. Test the vendor's own activity separately if it also performs a regulated function.
The limit

Vendor participation does not relocate a regulated client's recordkeeping, reporting, safeguarding, or examination duties, and it does not prove the vendor holds an independent regulatory permission. SR 23-4 is guidance, not a new vendor authorization rule.
Evidence
Circle Technology Services, LLC: Circle identifies CTS as CPN operator and technology service provider for participating financial institutions' CPN access and integration.
Evidence

Arc Network Services LLC: Arc disclosure identifies Arc Network Services LLC as launching Arc and says it provides software services only; it identifies a separate permissioned validator set as network operator.
Dated appointment

Circle Technology Services, LLC: CPN technology service provider for participating financial institutions' CPN access and integration. Circle says CTS operates CPN, provides the stated access and integration services, and is not a transaction party or account/funds manager. The assignment is contingent on the identified participant's CPN agreement and retained obligations.
Dated appointment

Arc Network Services LLC: Arc software-services provider. Arc's own disclosure identifies Arc Network Services LLC as providing software services only. No accountable client contract is named in the source, so this is not an assignment of a regulated function or of network operation.
